IC1: Inability to comply with study requirements.
IC3: Patients with orthopedic or neuromuscular disorders [OR] that preclude participation in exercise.
IC5: History of MI [OR], angina [OR] or congestive heart failure.
IC7: Patients that are high risk for moderate exercise based on ACSM risk classification.
IC8: Patients who exceed minimal physical activity recommendations from the US Surgeon General's Report: Accumulation of 30 minutes or more of moderate physical activity on most days of the week.
